trap.bear_trap.description: 对下张[adjacent]的怪物/道具造成{trap.bear_trap.fill.amount}点伤害/移除，触发后[death]

trap.echo_bell.description: 与本卡交战后，盘面旋转{trap.echo_bell.battle.count}格

trap.flame.description: 每移动{trap.flame.move.every}次，对[adjacent]的玩家造成{trap.flame.move.amount}点伤害，{trap.flame.remove.every}次后[death]

trap.gold_magnet.faceIntro: 吸走的钱总会吐出来的

trap.healing_spring.description: 每移动{trap.healing_spring.heal_on_move.every}次，若玩家在[adjacent]则恢复{trap.healing_spring.heal_on_move.amount}点[HP]

trap.hourglass.faceIntro: 沙漏不空，怪物不停变强

trap.leave.description: 魔免；只可被交战击破，[death]后离开房间

trap.offering_altar.description: 与本卡交战后，随机怪物受到{trap.offering_altar.battle.amount}点伤害

trap.recovery_totem.description: 每移动{trap.recovery_totem.heal_on_move.every}次，[adjacent]的怪物和玩家各恢复{trap.recovery_totem.heal_on_move.amount}点[HP]

trap.revive_stone.description: [action]{trap.revive_stone.interact.every}次后[death]，将{trap.revive_stone.remove.count}张巨剑骷髅打出到同格

trap.rolling_stone.description: 移动到格{trap.rolling_stone.slot3.slot}时，移除格{trap.rolling_stone.slot3.targetSlot}上的常规怪物/道具/机关

trap.spike.description: 每移动{trap.spike.move.every}次，[adjacent]的怪物和玩家各受到{trap.spike.move.amount}点伤害

trap.tutorial.attack.description: 点击相邻的卡发起攻击

trap.tutorial.deal.description: 开局发八张牌铺满场地

trap.tutorial.fire.description: 归零时攻击范围内的你
